items.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
items.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem
items.summary: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

items.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
items.summary: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

items.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
items.summary: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

items.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
items.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

items.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
items.summary: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.

items.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
items.summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
items.summary: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

items.title: Blockchain investigator Chainalysis hit by cybersecurity incident
items.summary: Chainalysis has engaged world-class third-party experts to support a review of its security and strengthen its defenses.

items.title: Binance $6.3B record hack sparks pre-election political clashes
items.summary: Some political and administration figures tried to make hay of the biggest-ever crypto heist.

items.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
items.summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

items.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

items.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

items.title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
items.summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.

items.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

items.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
items.summary: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
items.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

items.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
items.summary: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.
